name: Game rule: units fight
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game: cards attack the opposing lane, damage goes to the opponent when the lane is empty.

name: Game rule: Bones from deaths
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game: Bones: 1 per card of yours that dies (4 with Bone King).

name: Game rule: units can be sacrificed
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game: Costs: Blood (sacrifice your creatures).

name: Game rule: Blood costs
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game: Costs: Blood (sacrifice your creatures): a card costing Blood is played by sacrificing creatures of yours in play.

name: Game rule: Bones costs
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game: Costs: Bones (gained when your creatures die): a card costing Bones spends them.

name: Game rule: Green Mox costs
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game: Costs: Mox gems (gem cards on the board); a card costing a Green Mox is played while its owner has a Green gem.

name: Game rule: Orange Mox costs
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game: Costs: Mox gems (gem cards on the board); a card costing a Orange Mox is played while its owner has a Orange gem.

name: Game rule: Blue Mox costs
source: library/tools/games/inscryption.md, The game: Costs: Mox gems (gem cards on the board); a card costing a Blue Mox is played while its owner has a Blue gem.
